name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 37 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-08-04, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
